SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS 22851T1

TYPE | Rezoning Attachment
1830-1832 West 22" Place
From RS-3 to RM-5.5

The Property
The property is located in an RS-3 zoning district within a Transit Served location to the Blue Island (Route 60) Bus
Corridor.

The property is comprised of one zoning lot that includes two parcels: Lot 35 (1832 West 22™ Place) and Lot 36
(1830 West 22" Place).

Lot 35 is improved with a 3.5 story front residential front building (approx. 45.0 feet height) with three legal
dwelling units and 2 story rear residential building (approx. 45.0 feet height) with one illegal dwelling unit and two
parking spaces.

Lot 36 is improved with a two car garage.

The Project
GUZMAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP LLC (the “‘Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property from a RS-3, Residential

Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-5.5, Residential Multi-Unit District to subdivide the zoning lot into
two individual zoning lots: Lot 35 and Lot 36. The rezoning will allow three existing units on Lot 35’s front building
and the one existing unit on the rear building and to seek parking relief under the Transit Served Location
guidelines. The heights of the front and rear building on Lot 35 will remain the same. Two existing parking spaces
on Lot 35 will remain and no parking will be added.

The rezoning also will allow the Applicant to construct on Lot 36 a 4.5 story residential building with five dwelling
units and to seek parking relief under the transit Served Location guidelines. The proposed zoning height for Lot 36
will be 47.0 feet. Two existing parking spaces on Lot 36 will remain and no parking will be added.

The Applicant also is seeking all reliefas needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-!
application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including:

1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A to reduce the required front yard setback on Lot 35 under
section 17-2-0305(B) from 12.0 feet to zero;

2) an optional! variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required combined side yard setback for Lot 35
under section 17-2-0309-A from 4.8 feet to zero;

3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required east and west side setbacks for Lot 35
under section 17-2-0309-A from 2.0 feet to zero;

4) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required rear yard setback for Lot 35 under
section 17-2-0306-C from 30.0 feet to zero;

5) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1101!-A and 17-13-1003-EE to reduce | required parking space for the

illegal rear building unit to zero spaces for Lot 35 for properties located in a Transit Served Location under sections
17-10-0207 and 17-10-0102-B;

6) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A to reduce the required front yard setback on Lot 36 under
section 17-2-0305(B) from 12.0 feet to 7.75 feet;

7) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required rear yard setback for Lot 36 under
section 17-2-0306-C from 30.0 feet to 28.0 feet;

8) an optional variation under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-EE to reduce three required parking spaces to
two spaces for Lot 36 for properties located in a Transit Served Location under sections | 7-10-0207 and 17-10-0102-
B.
